title: RMOS-DRILLING-CONTRACT-001: truthful drilling authority contract, no gate
intent: Introduce a canonical drilling manufacturing-intent contract (DrillingOperationSpec) so compute_drilling_feasibility can be fed without fabrication. Adapt the intent lane truthfully. Keep modal G81/G83 200. Do not mark Drilling GOVERNED. Do not introduce an RMOS production gate.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) operation_contract.py: DrillingOperationSpec with explicit mm units, datum+target vs physical depth, first-class diameter, per-hole feeds, G81/G83 peck mapping, R-plane retract. (2) feasibility.py: thin from-spec adapter; scoring rules unchanged. (3) DrillReq: optional hole_diameter_mm and surface_z_mm; G-code generation unchanged. Pattern HTTP schema left untouched to avoid fence line-shift on pre-existing RunArtifact() sites. (4) intent_router uses the canonical adapter with the same kwargs. (5) Tests DRILL-CONTRACT-001–035. (6) Registry + overlay remain AUTHORITY_CONTRACT_MISMATCH / MISMATCH. (7) Audit §9 and GA-TRIAL-0005.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The live modal request cannot presently satisfy compute_drilling_feasibility. This increment makes the manufacturing semantics say what they mean without gating production or fabricating evaluator inputs from Hole.z or tool.
